title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 2 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The chart below shows the percentage of households in owned and rented accommodation in England and Wales between 1918 and 2011.
scenario: The chart compares the percentages of households living in owned and rented accommodation in England and Wales from 1918 to 2011.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
